text.en: Asha's grandmother took a tablet and said, "This is chemistry in your hands." Asha wanted to know how many ways chemistry helps us.

Nanochemistry deals with materials of extremely small size, nanoparticles, whose properties differ from those of the same material in bulk. They have many applications, though they also have drawbacks. Pharmaceutical chemistry is about drugs. A drug is a substance used to modify or explore body systems for the benefit of the person. Anaesthetics cause loss of sensation and antibiotics fight bacteria.
Electrochemistry uses an electrochemical cell, a device in which a chemical change produces electricity or electricity brings about a chemical change. It has two electrodes, the anode and the cathode. Radiochemistry studies radioactive decay, the change of an unstable radioisotope into another nucleus, with uses in medicine and industry.
Dye chemistry deals with substances that colour materials. Agricultural chemistry looks at fertilisers and pesticides and food chemistry at nutrients and preservatives. Forensic chemists examine evidence from crime scenes using scientific methods.

requiredIdeas.en: They do not cure viral infections.
